scope: Catalog actions from a read-only SOTA sweep for the mover v3 research plan: 5 angles, 37 items, each checked by at least two independent verifiers (5 survive, 24 contested, 8 killed). Only surviving items and contested items whose refutation the synthesis judged weak are recorded; killed items are listed in the plan's Dropped section. No record here involves installation, native execution, a paper order or a market-data fetch. Inclusion never upgrades an evidence level.

evidence_levels.literature_source_review: the primary paper was opened and read by a verifier; bibliographic and abstract-level claims only
evidence_levels.literature_metadata: the citation was located; the primary text was not read
evidence_levels.official_docs_metadata: an official vendor, broker, exchange or regulator page was read live on 2026-09-24
evidence_levels.unpinned_source_read: source files were fetched live without a pinned commit
evidence_levels.live_repository_metadata: a live GitHub API recheck of push date, licence and archive state
evidence_levels.existing_record: already recorded elsewhere in this repository with equal or stronger evidence

registration: Only /repository_decisions is registered with the decision index (python3 scripts/catalog_decisions.py --write --supplement catalogs/us-equities/mover-v3-sweep-20260924.json#/repository_decisions), because the union accepts only records that name a GitHub repository. /non_repository_decisions holds the papers, APIs, exchange pages and vendors as data.

non_repository_decisions.item: Bali, Cakici, Whitelaw (2011) MAX/lottery effect, as a caution prior for mover selection (H1)
non_repository_decisions.reason: Stocks selected on the largest recent daily return earn lower subsequent risk-adjusted returns. Monthly, cross-sectional evidence; carrying it over to catalyst-conditioned $1-50 movers is the H1 test.

non_repository_decisions.item: Lou, Polk, Skouras (2019) and Akbas, Boehmer, Jiang, Koch (2022), the overnight/intraday tug of war (H3)
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: the original citation was a secondary Lachance (2023) summary; the substance was not refuted
non_repository_decisions.reason: The corrected primaries replace the secondary summary. Both still need a direct read (DOIs unverified). Evidence comes from large, liquid names.

non_repository_decisions.item: Barber-Odean attention-buying line, downscoped to a prior on retail P&L (H2)
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: the refutation concerned a citation and the fit, not the direction
non_repository_decisions.reason: Retail buying of extreme-return, high-volume names is documented and not profitable for the buyer. This is not a rules-based backtest.

non_repository_decisions.item: Hong, Li, Ni, Scheinkman, Yan, days to cover (NBER w21166; SSRN 10.2139/ssrn.2568768), attached to the existing FINRA short-interest entry in blueprints/us-equities/acceptance-wave/factors-regimes.md (H5)
non_repository_decisions.reason: Days to cover beats the raw short ratio, and high days to cover predicts lower returns. Squeezes are episodic. Bi-monthly publication makes it an overlay only.

non_repository_decisions.item: Alpaca trailing_stop, OCO, bracket and OTO order classes as execution methods
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: trailing_stop survives; bracket contested and corrected to OCO for a held position (a bracket's take-profit closes the whole position); OTO folded
non_repository_decisions.native_execution: none; native paper execution is missing (H6)
non_repository_decisions.reason: Broker-held legs replace the client-side cancel-and-resubmit ratchet and cost no further calls when they fill.

non_repository_decisions.item: Alpaca DELETE /v2/orders batch cancel-all (HTTP 207 with a result for each order)
non_repository_decisions.reason: One call whatever the number of open orders, against native_adapter.py's one-call-per-order loop (line 391). Partial per-order failures must be reconciled against the durable ledger before adoption.

non_repository_decisions.item: Nasdaq Trader halt search, history and RSS pages
non_repository_decisions.reason: Free current and recent halts with reason codes. A web/RSS interface with a limited lookback, not a bulk archive: a pilot and a cross-check, not the primary historical halt source.

non_repository_decisions.item: LULD limit-state and reopening-auction execution states (SEC DERA papers; Nasdaq LULD material)
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: the execution-state idea survives; 'pause duration predicts post-reopen volatility' is corrected to a statement from DERA's literature review
non_repository_decisions.reason: Halted, then reopening auction, then post-auction: no fills through halts, exits priced at the auction or the first post-reopen print. Band tiers must be checked against the current LULD plan text before any hardcoding.

non_repository_decisions.item: SEC XBRL frames API as a float and shares-outstanding screen, confirmed through companyfacts
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: one misattributed source corrected; the claim stands
non_repository_decisions.reason: Public domain, 10 req/s. Frames returns the latest filed fact with no accession ID, so a name that clears the screen must be confirmed from companyfacts' dated per-accession fact before the float counts as point-in-time.

non_repository_decisions.item: Alpaca non-retail 1000/min ($0.004/share, wholesale routing given up) versus Elite 1000/min ($30k deposit), as an addendum to the Elite entries in catalogs/us-equities/runtime-target.json and paper-practice-20260921.md
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: facts confirmed; contested only on decision value
non_repository_decisions.reason: Capacity planning only. Throughput is capacity, not a trading target; 1000 round trips a minute is unreachable on one account, and sustained high rates are cost-bound first.

non_repository_decisions.item: Norgate Data US Platinum versus the in-repo SEC Form-25 delisting proxy
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: facts confirmed; not new (already named in catalogs/sota-convergence/manifest-20260923.json)
non_repository_decisions.native_execution: none; gated on a paid subscription the user must buy; EULA not read
non_repository_decisions.reason: The only named candidate for survivorship-free delisted history before 2020. Access ends when a subscription lapses, so any derived receipt needs its own licence review.

non_repository_decisions.item: VWAP-loss and ladder exit (Maroy, SSRN 5095349, posted 2025-01-12)
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: HTTP 403, not read; the '2026' date was corrected to 2025
non_repository_decisions.reason: A single working paper on SPY. An exploratory arm only, outside the v3 confirmatory family unless a pre-freeze amendment adds it.

non_repository_decisions.item: MacLean, Thorp, Ziemba (2010) fractional Kelly, as a sizing overlay applied only after a holdout pass
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: contested: a repository path in the proposal was misattributed; the idea stands
non_repository_decisions.reason: Edge shrink stays 0 until a v3 rule passes its holdout, then at most half-Kelly with estimation-error shrinkage, always under the leverage-schedule-v1 ceiling and safety.py hard caps. The full text (Quantitative Finance 10(7):681-687) was not opened.

non_repository_decisions.item: Qullamaggie breakout scanner (duplicates the catalogued tradermonty/claude-trading-skills vcp-screener) and the backtrader family
non_repository_decisions.sweep_status: scanner contested (duplicate); backtrader-family-closed killed (duplicates the catalog)
non_repository_decisions.reason: Recorded so the next sweep does not re-search them. The scanner is a single-maintainer, yfinance-only project (MIT, pushed 2026-09-16); only its feature vocabulary is of interest, and it is already covered. backtrader: GPL-3.0, last push 2024-08-19.
